turns.query: From SEC submissions metadata, identify Apple's non-amended Forms 10-Q for report dates 2025-03-29 and 2025-06-28. For the earlier six-month filing and the later nine-month filing, report the accession number and EDGAR acceptance timestamp. Explain the difference between a report date and an acceptance timestamp.

claims.description: The response distinguishes each fiscal report date from the later timestamp when EDGAR accepted the filing.

turns.query: Using those two accessions, retrieve Apple's cumulative operating cash flow and payments to acquire property, plant and equipment from Company Facts, requiring the four facts to share the fiscal-year start date 2024-09-29. Report the six- and nine-month operating cash flow and capital expenditures as positive outflows in USD billions. Derive standalone third-quarter free cash flow as the nine-month minus six-month operating-cash-flow difference, less the corresponding capital-expenditure difference. Explain the derivation and the scope of the resulting measure.

claims.description: The response uses fiscal-2025 six- and nine-month operating cash flow and capex values sharing the same fiscal-year start date.
The response subtracts each six-month cumulative value from its nine-month counterpart before subtracting standalone-quarter capex from standalone-quarter operating cash flow.
The response labels the result as a derived standalone-quarter measure under the stated formula rather than a directly reported GAAP subtotal.
If the response discusses sustainability, quality, valuation or investment merit, it does not present those conclusions as established by this one derived quarter alone.

judge_reference.source: SEC CompanyFacts and submissions frozen at 2025-12-31
facts: Fiscal-2025 six- and nine-month operating cash flow were 53.887 and 81.754 billion USD.
Fiscal-2025 six- and nine-month capex were 6.011 and 9.473 billion USD.
Standalone Q3 operating cash flow was 27.867 billion USD, standalone Q3 capex was 3.462 billion USD and derived standalone Q3 free cash flow was 24.405 billion USD.
known_overclaims: Using the nine-month cash-flow value as the standalone quarter.
Subtracting cumulative nine-month capex directly from standalone operating cash flow.
Calling the result a directly reported GAAP free-cash-flow subtotal.
